descriptions.preferred: 夏金，由意大利米兰 的 Fratelli Ghiradelli 哥拉德利苗圃选育并推广，夏金是 鸡爪槭和白泽槭的杂交品种，具有典型的白泽槭特性， 叶圆且种子直立向上，而非鸡爪槭式的下垂式生长， 夏金春叶为明亮的黄色，并有红色的叶边，超级漂亮。 黄叶系列，夏季为黄绿色，目前唯一的夏季黄叶品种， 秋季为橙色或者火红色。生长健壮，可全日照，成年 树可达 3 米左右高度。

rhs.description: A small, slow-growing, upright tree with a rounded crown, ultimately reaching 2m in height and spread. The leaves have seven lobes, open pink in spring, then lime green to yellow with a fine red edge in summer and golden yellow with orange and red shades in autumn. Inconspicuous flowers in spring are followed by red, winged fruit held above the foliage in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grows best in slightly acidic, humus-rich, well-drained soil, but tolerates most soils if improved with well-rotted organic matter . Hot, dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by semi-hardwood cuttings or by layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 夏金，由意大利米兰 的 Fratelli Ghiradelli 哥拉德利苗圃选育并推广，夏金是 鸡爪槭和白泽槭的杂交品种，具有典型的白泽槭特性， 叶圆且种子直立向上，而非鸡爪槭式的下垂式生长， 夏金春叶为明亮的黄色，并有红色的叶边，超级漂亮。 黄叶系列，夏季为黄绿色，目前唯一的夏季黄叶品种， 秋季为橙色或者火红色。生长健壮，可全日照，成年 树可达 3 米左右高度。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 在微酸性、富含腐殖质且排水良好的土壤中生长最佳，但若加入充分腐熟的有机质改良，也能适应多数土壤。炎热干燥的空气、寒风和晚霜可能导致叶片焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根免受寒害和干燥。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.propagation: 可采用半成熟枝扦插或压条繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 小型、缓慢生长的直立树种，树冠圆整，最终高和冠幅均可达 2 米。叶片 7 裂，春季展叶时为粉色，夏季转为青柠绿至黄色并带细窄红边，秋季则呈金黄色并带橙色和红色晕染。春季开不显眼的小花，秋季在叶幕上方可见红色翅果。

products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Summer Gold' Golden Yellow - Heat Tolerant Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Summer Gold' leafs out as bright chartreuse to yellow green with a red border. The leaf on 'Summer Gold' brightens to gold as the summer progresses providing a dynamic contrast with both red and green maples. This may be one the most heat tolerant selections of the golden leaf types as this maple does not show any burn when grown in full sun in the mountains of North Carolina. Fall color is a deep bright orange to fiery red. This Italian selection by Ghiradelli Nursery is a summer delight in the garden. 'Summer Gold' will reach 6-8 ft in 10 years making it the perfect mid-sized golden tree for your garden or landscape. These 10 gallon trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.
